indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Constant prices, Percent change
description: Real GDP growth: how much more the economy produced than the year before, with inflation taken out.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Current prices, US dollar
description: The size of the economy: everything it produced in the year, converted to US dollars at the year's average exchange rate.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Current prices, Purchasing power parity (PPP) international dollar, ICP benchmarks 2017-2021
description: The size of the economy at purchasing power parity, which adjusts for prices differing between countries.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Purchasing power parity (PPP) international dollar, percent of world GDP, Percent, ICP benchmarks 2017-2021
description: The country's share of the world economy, at purchasing power parity.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Current prices, Domestic currency
description: Everything the economy produced in the year, at that year's prices, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Constant prices, Domestic currency
description: GDP with inflation taken out, in the country's own currency. Real growth is its percent change.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Current prices, Fiscal year, Domestic currency
description: GDP at current prices over the government's fiscal year, the base for fiscal ratios where that year is not the calendar year.

indicator_name: Output gap, Percent of potential GDP
description: The output gap: how far the economy runs above (positive) or below (negative) what it could produce. Reported for some advanced economies.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Current prices, Per capita, US dollar
description: GDP in US dollars divided by population: a rough measure of average income.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Per capita, purchasing power parity (PPP) international dollar, ICP benchmarks 2017-2021
description: GDP per person at purchasing power parity, which adjusts for prices differing between countries: the usual measure for comparing living standards.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Constant prices, Per capita, purchasing power parity (PPP) international dollar, ICP benchmark 2021
description: GDP per person at purchasing power parity with inflation taken out, for comparing living standards over time.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Current prices, Per capita, Domestic currency
description: GDP per person at current prices, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Constant prices, Per capita, Domestic currency
description: GDP per person with inflation taken out, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Rate, Domestic currency per international dollar in PPP terms, ICP benchmarks 2017-2021
description: The purchasing power parity rate: how many units of the country's currency buy what one US dollar buys in the United States.

indicator_name: All Items, Consumer price index (CPI), Period average, percent change
description: Inflation: how much consumer prices rose on average over the year. The headline measure.

indicator_name: All Items, Consumer price index (CPI), End-of-period (EoP), percent change
description: Inflation measured from the end of one year to the end of the next.

indicator_name: All Items, Consumer price index (CPI), Period average
description: The level of consumer prices, averaged over the year.

indicator_name: All Items, Consumer price index (CPI), End-of-period (EoP)
description: The level of consumer prices at the end of the year.

indicator_name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Price deflator, Index
description: The price level of everything in GDP. Its change is a broad measure of inflation.

indicator_name: Population, Persons for countries / Index for country groups
description: The number of people living in the country.

indicator_name: Unemployment rate
description: The unemployment rate: the share of people who want a job and do not have one. Many lower-income countries do not report it.

indicator_name: Employed persons, Persons for countries / Index for country groups
description: The number of people with a job. Reported mostly for advanced economies.

indicator_name: Current account balance (credit less debit), Percent of GDP
description: The current account balance as a share of the economy: what the country earns from the rest of the world minus what it pays. Negative means a deficit.

indicator_name: Current account balance (credit less debit), US dollar
description: The current account balance in dollars: trade in goods and services, income and transfers with the rest of the world.

indicator_name: Exports of goods and services, Volume, Free on board (FOB), Percent change
description: Growth in the volume of goods and services the country exports.

indicator_name: Exports of goods, Volume, Free on board (FOB), Percent change
description: Growth in the volume of goods the country exports.

indicator_name: Imports of goods and services, Volume, Cost insurance freight (CIF), Percent change
description: Growth in the volume of goods and services the country imports.

indicator_name: Imports of goods, Volume, Cost insurance freight (CIF), Percent change
description: Growth in the volume of goods the country imports.

indicator_name: Gross national savings, Percent of GDP
description: National savings: what households, firms and the government save together, as a share of the economy.

indicator_name: Gross capital formation, Percent of GDP
description: Investment: spending on buildings, machines, infrastructure and inventories, as a share of the economy.

indicator_name: Revenue, General government, Percent of GDP
description: Government revenue as a share of the economy: taxes, social contributions, grants and other income.

indicator_name: Expenditure, General government, Percent of GDP
description: Government spending as a share of the economy, interest included.

indicator_name: Net lending (+) / net borrowing (-), General government, Percent of GDP
description: The overall balance: government revenue minus all spending, as a share of the economy. Negative means a deficit.

indicator_name: Primary net lending (+) / net borrowing (-), General government, Percent of GDP
description: The primary balance: the overall balance with interest left out, both the interest the government pays and the interest it earns. Primary minus overall is net interest.

indicator_name: Structural balance, General government, Percent
description: The structural balance: the government's balance adjusted for the ups and downs of the business cycle. Reported for fewer than half of countries.

indicator_name: Gross debt, General government, Percent of GDP
description: Gross government debt as a share of the economy: everything the government owes. The most quoted measure of public debt.

indicator_name: Net debt, General government, Percent of GDP
description: Net government debt as a share of the economy: gross debt minus the government's financial assets. Reported for fewer than half of countries.

indicator_name: Revenue, General government, Domestic currency
description: Government revenue, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Expenditure, General government, Domestic currency
description: Government spending, interest included, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Net lending (+) / net borrowing (-), General government, Domestic currency
description: The overall balance, in the country's own currency. Negative means a deficit, which the government borrows to cover.

indicator_name: Primary net lending (+) / net borrowing (-), General government, Domestic currency
description: The primary balance, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Structural balance, General government, Domestic currency
description: The structural balance, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Gross debt, General government, Domestic currency
description: Gross government debt, in the country's own currency.

indicator_name: Net debt, General government, Domestic currency
description: Net government debt, in the country's own currency.
